units: <cite ref="Chullin 131a">Ḥull. 131ᵃ</cite>, sq. (ref. to <he>תְפָאֵר</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:20">Deut. XXIV, 20</cite>) <he>שלא תטול תפארתו ממנו</he> thou must not cut the crown off it (the last berries).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:5">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>כל מה … לגדלן ולפָאֲרָן פָּאֵר … להִתְפָּאֵר בהם</he> as much as thou canst praise Israel, praise, as much as thou canst raise and glorify them, glorify, for I am to be glorified through them; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 8; Pesik. Shek., p. 17ᵇ <he>לפָאֲרוֹ פָּאֲרוֹ</he>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוֹאָר</he>; f. <he>מְפוֹאָרָה</he>, <he>מְפוֹאֶרֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Taanit 7a:17">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite> (to R. Joshua) <he>אי חכמה מפ׳ בכלי מכוער</he> O for that glorious wisdom in an ugly vessel! <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00133"><he>עֲדִי</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 284:3">Sifré Deut. 284</cite> (ref. to <he>תפאר</he>, v. supra) <he>לא תִתְפָּאֵר לעני</he> do not make thyself the master of the poor man (i.e. do not decide who shall and who shall not get the gleanings &c.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 937">Yalk. ib. 937</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be adorned, glorified. Lev. R. l. c., a. e., v. supra.
